messages.subject: Source delivered; strict metric qualification HOLD
messages.body: Delivered the source-only tiny MetricQuery controller, strict offline readers, capped full-catalog enumerator revision, complete immutable-base deltas and provenance under bench/results/2026-10-15-pr6-recovery-audit/own-metric-query-tiny-v1. Main must review package SHA256 080316bd939dd5a34934dfc3b7ece2cf3871bf84d5195379773b3c733ff6987c, resolve exact internal API-status preservation, and own offline/dependency/full-catalog/build/fixture validation; this worker ran no builds, syntax checks, tests, native or GPU work.

messages.subject: Historical QSA route reconstructed
messages.body: I traced the timed PR6 environment through the pinned restored source resolver and call graph, and compared it with the current measured matrix launch. The reconstructed route selects INT8 K/V decode-attention variant 4 in 128-query batches, while the exact historical binary route remains source-inferred because its full JIT build recipe is unavailable. The 1,581-word decision report identifies compute tradeoffs, bounds risks, and two isolated qualification experiments; implementation and device qualification remain with Main.
